groups.name: spring.actor
groups.description: Actor system settings. The typed keys (spring.actor.name, spring.actor.provider, spring.actor.remote.*, spring.actor.cluster.*, spring.actor.shutdown.timeout) set the matching Pekko keys. Any Pekko key can also be set raw under spring.actor.pekko.* (for example spring.actor.pekko.loglevel): it is passed to Pekko with the spring.actor prefix removed, and it wins over a typed key that sets the same Pekko key, with a warning. Comma-separated raw values are turned into lists.

properties.name: management.health.actor.enabled
properties.description: Whether to report the actor system and, in cluster mode, this node's cluster membership as Actuator health components (actorSystem, actorCluster).

properties.name: spring.actor.dispatchers.*.executor
properties.description: Name of the Executor bean (for example a ThreadPoolTaskExecutor) the actors of this dispatcher run on. Replace * with the dispatcher name.

properties.name: spring.actor.dispatchers.*.virtual
properties.description: Runs the actors of this dispatcher on virtual threads, one per task, instead of an Executor bean. Replace * with the dispatcher name.

properties.name: spring.actor.dispatchers.*.throughput
properties.description: Messages an actor of this dispatcher processes before its thread goes to the next actor. Pekko's default is 5. Replace * with the dispatcher name.
